def Strongest_Extension(class_name, extensions):
    """Return the class name joined to the first strongest extension."""
    strongest = max(
        extensions,
        key=lambda name: sum(c.isupper() for c in name)
        - sum(c.islower() for c in name),
    )
    return f"{class_name}.{strongest}"
